data_pending: Data pulled 2026-11-21 via Census API (ACS 2024 5-year + PL 2020); extension variables (race, Hispanic origin, poverty, education) pulled 2026-11-21.
global_caveats: Census units render WHOLE across the three counties; the watershed polygon mutes what lies outside, client-side. No areal allocation, no population-weighted splits. 2020 PL is a usual-residence count (April 1, 2020) — the summer population is invisible in it; the seasonal-home stock (ACS B25004_006E) is the measure of the vacation-home presence, not a population count. AIAN-area ACS follows the Census AIAN boundary (land-only, ~623k ac) while the viewer's displayed BIA reservation geometry measures ~824k ac — same acreage footnote as the reservation layer.

census-blockgroups.geojson.caveats: 84 block groups: Beltrami 37, Cass 29, Hubbard 18 (statewide file holds 4,703). 500k files are generalized for small-scale display — fine at watershed zoom, approximate at parcel zoom. Datum NAD83, carried as lon/lat and treated as WGS84 by the viewer (difference under 2 m). All geometries validated with shapely; 0 invalid skipped. Data values (population, seasonal homes, income) are NOT in this file — they come from scripts/pull_census_data.py, which needs a free Census API key.
census-blockgroups.geojson.query: TIGER/Line 2024 cartographic boundary (500k) block groups, state 27; filtered to whole counties Beltrami (007), Cass (021), Hubbard (057) only — NOT clipped to the watershed (Paul's design rule, Nov 21, 2026: census units render whole; the watershed polygon mutes what lies outside, client-side)

census-tracts.geojson.caveats: 32 tracts: Beltrami 14, Cass 11, Hubbard 7 (statewide file holds 1,502). Tracts are the aggregation fallback when block-group MOEs are too large to map. Same 500k generalization and NAD83 notes as the block-group file. Data values come from scripts/pull_census_data.py (Census API key required).
census-tracts.geojson.query: TIGER/Line 2024 cartographic boundary (500k) tracts, state 27; filtered to whole counties Beltrami (007), Cass (021), Hubbard (057) only — NOT clipped to the watershed

census-blockgroups-data.geojson.caveats: ACS block-group MOEs are large, often +/-30-50% of the estimate; every estimate is stored with its MOE (fields ending in M) and must show it in the popup. Derived shares use root-sum-of-squares MOEs for summed age bands. -666666666 (not applicable) stored as null. Values are for WHOLE census units; nothing is clipped or allocated to the watershed.
